# Course Description  
**MASTER IN (FAITH)**

---

**0401761** The Doctrine of Divinity and Predestination (3cr)  
Includes studying monotheism and methodologies of proving the existence of God Al-mighty, believing in the predestination and opinions of scholars in this regard, the scholars’ viewpoints regarding deeds of human beings, the subject of guidance and misguidance and God’s will in the universe.

---

**0401762** The Doctrine of Prophethood and Hereafter (3cr)  
Includes studying the phenomenon of revelation, proving the Prophethood, miracles, infallibility, sealing of Prophethood and believing in prophets and messengers.

---

**0401763** The Heavenly Religions (3cr)  
Includes studying legislations, history, teachings, thoughts, worships, holidays and sects in Judaism and Christianity. This study will be compared with Islam.

---

**0401764** Sects and Faith Schools of Thought (3cr)  
Includes studying Islamic faith schools of thought which have appeared during different ages, their impact on Islamic society till our time, such as Kharijites, Shi’ats, Mo’tazilitate and Ahl-Assonah.

---

**0401765** Logic and Research Methodology (3cr)  
Includes studying the definition of logic and the history of logical studies and their development in the Islamic thought and what was the attitudes of Muslim scholars towards them. It deals also with the methodologies of research and writings in the Islamic Faith and Philosophical studies.

---

**0401766** The Theory of Epistemology in Islam (3cr)  
Includes studying the concept of the theory of epistemology and its status in the mentality of the religious and philosophical thinking and the origins of this theory in the Qur’an and the Sunnah.

---

**0401767** Islam and Philosophy (3cr)  
Includes studying the concept and history of philosophy, the most important schools in ancient philosophy, Islamic philosophy, the middle ages philosophy and modern philosophy.
